name: startnet-website
description: startnet.in — Tamil Nadu's founder-making network. React (Vite) front end + NestJS API.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix tools/audit
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && npm run prerender
